Package com.helix.core.cache.l4

Class BytecodeCodec

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.cache.l4.BytecodeCodec
public final class BytecodeCodec extends Object
Binary serialization codec for compiled JVM rule bytecode and associated metadata. Uses a compact binary framing format with the magic header 0x48454C58 ("HELX").
